verdict.rationale: The Division documents a public way to check work-order status: the Contact Us page has a "Work Request Status" option. It also supports text/email alerts when filings are added to the public record, and a public Standing Certificate search shows an entity's standing. However, the status check goes through a contact form, and the evidence never shows a self-service tracker that returns the status of a pending filing or application directly. Missing for 10: a dedicated real-time filing/application status lookup page, evidence of what the Work Request Status option actually returns, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
